trigger_condition: delivery_date < TODAY() AND no CHR shipment record exists
ai_recommendation_pattern: PO past due — no CHR shipment. Escalate to supplier.

trigger_condition: asn_status = IDOC_Error AND idoc_error_msg contains 'not extended'
ai_recommendation_pattern: IDOC failed. [error detail]. Resolve MM02 and reprocess IDOC.

trigger_condition: asn_status = IDOC_Error AND idoc_error_msg contains mismatch keywords
ai_recommendation_pattern: Data mismatch on IDOC. Reject and request corrected 856.

trigger_condition: ibd_qty IS NOT NULL AND ibd_qty <> po_qty
ai_recommendation_pattern: Qty mismatch: PO=X, IBD=Y. Investigate short shipment.

trigger_condition: total_legs > 1 AND final leg status = Created/Pending AND days_to_due <= 3
ai_recommendation_pattern: Shipment N/X not picked up. X units remaining. Risk to PO date.

trigger_condition: bol_number IS NOT NULL AND bol_chr IS NOT NULL AND bol_number <> bol_chr
ai_recommendation_pattern: BOL mismatch: CHR=XXXX, ASN=YYYY. Verify with carrier.

trigger_condition: asn_status IN (Error, Pending) AND chr_status IN (PickedUp, Created, NULL)
ai_recommendation_pattern: In transit. Follow up with supplier on 856/ASN.

trigger_condition: ibd_qty = po_qty AND chr_status = Delivered AND gr_qty = 0
ai_recommendation_pattern: Proceed with GR posting. Qty matches PO.

trigger_condition: asn_status IN (Received, In_Transit) AND chr_status IN (PickedUp, InTransit)
ai_recommendation_pattern: ASN received, in transit. GR expected by [est_delivery].

trigger_condition: ibd_qty IS NOT NULL AND no CHR event exists
ai_recommendation_pattern: Inbound delivery exists but no carrier tracking events. Follow up with carrier.
